text:
marta: Quick heads up — change window tonight 00:00-02:00 UTC. Plan: v3.7.2 -> v3.8 runtime rollout with staged traffic. Need final checklist and owners.
ryan: ping checklist pls (smoke owner, rollback commit, holdpoints).
marta: smoke: ashley, rollback commit pinned to abc123, observability dashboard link, holdpoint at 30% then 60%.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary at 00:15 UTC. Will apply model pin r3a-quant for canary.
ashley: I can run smoke-suite at T-10 and report. I'll verify p95 and error rate.
sasha: fyi embeddings batch jobs run at 01:10, we should shift those to the background queue to avoid noise.
karen: rollback playbook ready. Command to rollback: ```
deploy rollback --to abc123 --reason "latency spike or token error"
```
ryan: please create holdpoint with deploy-bot: traffic=30%, approvers=marta,ryan
deploy-bot: holdpoint created: id=hp-759, traffic=30%, approvers=[marta, ryan] :white_check_mark:
marta: acceptance criteria before ramp: smoke green, p95 < 120ms, token error < 0.1%. If any > thresholds, rollback.
ashley: running smoke now — will post results in 10m.
ashley: smoke results: 12/12 checks passed, p95=98ms, token error=0.02% :tada:
sasha: observability: https://console.redwood/launch/3161616161 (dashboard with traces + error heatmap)
ryan: QA on standby. I'll tail pods/logs during canary.
marta: ok. If no flags by 00:45, ramp to 60% for 10m then continue. I'm oncall for the window.
deploy-bot: canary started at 00:15, traffic=30%
deploy-bot: canary 15m check: no anomalies detected in the first 15m
marta: ramp to 60% now.
deploy-bot: traffic increased to 60%, monitoring for 10m
ashley: seeing a small uptick in token errors at minute 8 post-ramp -> 0.15% (baseline 0.02%)
marta: pause ramp. Threshold is 0.2% so still under threshold but close. Pause and investigate.
deploy-bot: pause ramp executed. Traffic held at 60%. Awaiting manual confirm to continue.
ryan: digging into logs now, tailing inference pods. Seeing increased 5xxs on pod inference-7 and elevated latency on that pod.
sasha: allocating dedicated queue for embeddings to reduce contention, will shift jobs in 3m.
karen: if we don't see improvement in 15m, we'll rollback to abc123.
oncall: tagging oncall to watch for escalation.
marta: agreed. If error rate >= 0.2% or p95 >= 200ms for more than 5m, rollback immediately.
ashley: running targeted load on pod inference-7 to reproduce, posting logs snippet if found.
ryan: found an OOM restart in inference-7 at 00:47, investigating memory graph. Might be a quantization edge-case.
deploy-bot: manual rollback approved by marta and ryan. Executing rollback to abc123 now.
deploy-bot: rollback completed at 00:52. Traffic restored to previous stable route.
marta: postmortem / brief notes: cause suspected memory regression on r3a-quant path; create follow-up ticket with repro and heapdump. Thank you all for fast action.
ashley: filing ticket now and attaching smoke logs.
sasha: I'll keep embeddings queued to background for the rest of the window.
ryan: QA verified stability post-rollback. Closing the loop.
marta: nice work. We'll reschedule a smaller test with isolations before reattempting the ramp. :white_check_mark:
